name: tagline
string_value: A community bank's commercial book — loans, covenants, CDD, and the watchlist.

name: description_rich
string_value: Effortless Banking models a community bank's commercial relationship-management desk — five small-business borrowers, five bank employees, three funded loans, the covenants attached to them, the CDD beneficial-ownership file, and the activity stream the regulators eventually audit. The interesting thing isn't the data, it's that **every regulated rule lives in the rulebook**: the FinCEN 25%-or-control-person CDD test, the substandard-asset threshold (RiskRating ≥ 7), the watchlist union of *classified OR breached covenant*, the segregation-of-duties check that the originating RM cannot also be the underwriter — all of it is calculated fields wired into a DAG. The same answer Postgres returns to the credit committee is the same answer the Python conformance tests assert. There is no second copy of the rules hiding in application code.

name: use_cases
json_value: ["**Watch a loan cross the classified-asset line.** Open *L-0042 (Pine Hardware)*'s `RiskRatingHistory`: the 2025-08-15 row carries PriorGrade=6, NewGrade=7, and `CrossedClassifiedThreshold` flips to TRUE — the moment the loan becomes a regulator-reportable classified asset.", "**Confirm CDD on a new prospect.** Hilltop Bakery is a Prospect with no BeneficialOwners attached yet — `MeetsCddRule` is FALSE and `PortfolioPriority` reads 'Medium'. Add owners totalling ≥25% (or a designated control person) and the rule clears the same instant the rulebook recomputes.", "**Enforce segregation of duties.** Try to set L-0051's Underwriter to the same user as its OriginatingRM (Devon Marshall) and `SegregationOfDutiesOk` falls to FALSE. The same flag is exposed identically in Postgres and Python — no app-side guard to forget.", "**Trace a covenant breach into the activity feed.** L-0042's MinDSCR covenant is in Breached status; the matching SystemEvent Interaction on 2025-05-02 lives in the same stream as human-logged calls and visits, so the audit trail and the RM's daily feed are one table, not two.", "**Read the watchlist in two substrates.** Ask *'which loans are on the watchlist?'* of the Postgres view, then of the Python module — both return L-0042 because `OnWatchlist` is the same calculated field on both sides."]

name: journal_seed
string_value: Three funded loans, one classified — L-0042 (Pine Hardware) crossed into Substandard in August and its DSCR covenant is in breach. The rest of the book is clean; Hilltop Bakery is one CDD file away from becoming a customer.
